jobs.description: Join D.Med Consulting GmbH – Pioneering Medical Device TechnologiesD.Med Consulting GmbH, headquartered in Hamburg, Germany, is a joint venture between Fresenius Medical Care AG (51%) and the D.Med Healthcare Group (49%). Founded in 2011, we are a leading provider of research, development and consulting services specializing in extracorporeal therapies. The collaboration with Fresenius Medical Care, the world leader in renal care, and the D.Med Healthcare Group, a renowned provider in nephrology, cardiology, and internal medicine, allows us to offer a comprehensive range of services from concept to implementation. Join our team of dedicated professionals and contribute to groundbreaking advancements in medical device technology. Join us and experience a true partnership in innovation – working hand-in-hand to achieve our customer goals.For our office in Hamburg and at the earliest possible starting date we are looking in part or full-time for aRisk Manager (Medical Devices) (m/f/d)We are a dynamic consulting firm in the medical technology sector, driven by a clear ambition: to support companies in developing sustainable and forward-looking solutions. At the heart of our work is a dedicated team that takes ownership, thinks ahead, and brings fresh ideas to life.To strengthen our team, we are looking for an experienced Risk Manager Medical Devices who is passionate about safety, regulatory compliance, and innovative medical technologies. In this role, you will support our clients throughout the entire product lifecycle by identifying and evaluating risks, developing effective mitigation strategies, and ensuring compliance with international regulatory requirements. If you enjoy working at the intersection of technology, regulation, and innovation, while valuing both independent responsibility and close teamwork, you’ll fit perfectly into our team.Your responsibilities:- Risk Management: Identification, analysis, evaluation, and documentation of product-related risks for medical devices in accordance with ISO 14971- Hazard Assessment: Evaluation of safety-relevant hazards in close collaboration with technical experts- Risk Control Support: Supporting cross-functional project teams in the technical development and implementation of risk control measures, including the analysis of their effectiveness- Regulatory Compliance: Identification, investigation, and GAP analysis of international regulatory requirements for medical devices- Technical Documentation: Creation, review, and continuous maintenance of technical documentation in line with applicable standards and regulatory frameworks- Market Access Strategy: Development of tailored market access and regulatory strategies for active, non-active medical devices, and Software as a Medical Device (SaMD)Your profile:- Educational background: Completed technical degree in a relevant field such as medical technology, engineering, computer science, or physics- Professional experience: Several years of experience in product development, risk management, quality management, or regulatory affairs for medical devices- Technical expertise: Strong understanding of complex systems involving mechanics, software, and hardware- Regulatory & standards knowledge: Solid knowledge of key regulations and standards, including MDR, ISO 14971, ISO 13485, IEC 62304, as well as safety analysis methods like FMEA and FTA- Soft skills: Excellent communication skills and a strong team player mindset- Working style: Self-driven, structured, and results-oriented approach to work- Analytical abilities: Strong analytical thinking and confident decision-making capabilities- Language skills: Fluency in English (spoken and written); German skills are a plusWhat we offer: - A diversified and challenging environment combined with a high degree of freedom for the implementation of innovative ideas- A permanent employment contract with performance-related pay at an international and promising employer- A modern workplace in spacious and bright offices in the heart of Hamburg with a view of the River Elbe- A supportive working atmosphere in a dynamic team with short decision paths- An individually tailored “on the job” training and professional development opportunities- Personal added values such as a company pension scheme, team events, employee discounts, bike leasing and much moreJoin us in shaping the future of healthcare by ensuring the safety and reliability of life-saving medical devices — your expertise in risk management can make a real difference. Please send your application to application@dmed-healthcare.com or click “Apply for job.We are looking forward to meeting you!D.Med Consulting GmbH | Bernhard-Nocht-Str. 99 | 20359 Hamburg | +49 211 650 415 14Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach Vereinbarung

jobs.description: Work Your Magic with us!Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.Your roleAs a Global Category Manager for Site Services, you will sit at the heart of a worldwide Technical Sourcing organization, shaping the procurement strategies that underpin some of the most significant capital and operational investments across a global science and technology enterprise. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role for an experienced procurement professional who thrives on complexity, drives value at scale, and influences outcomes across organizational boundaries without relying on direct authority.You will own and continuously evolve the global category strategy for Site Services – spanning Equipment and Components, Construction, and Energy – directly aligned to capital investment plans and long-term business priorities. Applying a spend entrepreneurship mindset, you will lead rigorous end-to-end sourcing programs: from market analysis, supplier segmentation, and total cost of ownership modeling through to contract conclusion and claim management.You will build and govern a high-performing strategic supplier portfolio, establish structured supplier relationship management programs with clear key performance indicator frameworks and governance cadences, and ensure resilient, multi-region supply continuity. Acting as a trusted counterpart toManufacturing, Engineering, Operations, Finance, Legal, and Compliance stakeholders across all business sectors, you will coordinate virtual global category teams across the Americas, Europe, and Asia – generating cross- project synergies and delivering quantifiable, sustained value improvements with full transparency to senior leadershipWho you are• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Economics, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field; equivalent professional experience is equally valued.• 8–12+ years of progressive experience in strategic sourcing and category management, with a strong track record in indirect, technical, or engineering-related procurement within complex, multinational environments – ideally in life sciences, healthcare, or electronics.• Demonstrated expertise in developing and executing global category strategies, including capital expenditure and operational expenditure procurement, supplier relationship management, contract negotiations, and multi-region supplier governance.• Exceptional analytical and commercial acumen: fluency in total cost of ownership modeling, spend analytics, should-cost analysis, and advanced negotiation strategies, with the ability to translate technical requirements into compelling procurement solutions.• Outstanding stakeholder management and influencing skills; proven ability to lead without formal authority in a matrixed global organization and to present data-driven business cases to senior leadership.• Solid understanding of compliance-intensive environments, including Good Manufacturing Practice standards and sustainable procurement practices aligned to environmental, social, and governance principles.• Demonstrated ability to engage with artificial intelligence tools and concepts – including their practical applications, limitations, and ethical implications – to support informed, responsible decision-making in a procurement context.• Business fluency in English is required; proficiency in German, French, Mandarin, or other languages is a distinct advantage.What we offer: We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

and engineering changes.- Support audits and ensure compliance with regulatory and corporate requirements.EducationBachelor’s or Master’s degree in one of the following disciplines:- Electrical/ Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:Strategic Lead Talent ManagementStellenbeschreibung:Company DescriptionContinental is a leading tire manufacturer and industry specialist. Founded in 1871, the company generated sales of €19.7 billion in 2025 and currently employs around 76,000 people in 54 countries and markets.Tire solutions from the Tires group sector make mobility safer, smarter, and more sustainable. Its premium portfolio encompasses car, truck, bus, two-wheel, and specialty tires as well as smart solutions and services for fleets and tire retailers. Continental has been delivering top performance for more than 150 years and is one of the world’s largest tire manufacturers. In fiscal 2025, the Tires group sector generated sales of 13.8 billion euros. Continental's tire division currently employs around 53,000 people worldwide and has 19 production and 16 development sites.Job DescriptionThis role contributes significantly to the development and execution of a global Talent Management strategy. It combines strategic project leadership with hands-on implementation in close collaboration with global HR stakeholders.Key Responsibilities:- Define, implement and adapt global Talent Management strategies and standards- Supports Head of CoE with preparation and conducting Sector Talent Conference- Lead strategic projects and ensure alignment across business areas and countries- Select, implement and maintain central Talent Management tools; provide training and user support- Provide expert advise HR and business managers, foster communities and track market trends- Ensure compliance, define KPIs and monitor process effectiveness- Manage external providers, contracts and service deliveryQualifications- A bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, Organizational Development, or a related field is required; a master’s degree in Human Resources, Organizational or Leadership Development is preferred- Several years of professional experience in Human Resources, gained through cross-functional projects or diverse assignments, with strong expertise in operational Talent Management- Demonstrated success in leading international projects and facilitating Talent Conferences and Talent Review Meetings; experience in formal team leadership is considered an asset- Fluent in English, both written and spoken- Excellent communication and organizational skillsApplications from severely handicapped people are welcome.Additional Information- Attractive compensation: We reward exceptional qualifications and experience with an above-tariff salary with the option of an variable compensation.- Flexibility that fits your life: This position is generally intended to be filled on a full-time basis. At the same time, we are open to individual part-time arrangements, provided they are compatible with the requirements of the role.
